description.value: Queensborough Community Centre is a civic, two-storey recreation facility operated by New Westminster Parks and Recreation Department, situated in the Queensborough neighbourhood—a relatively isolated community on the south arm of the Fraser River. As the primary public recreation hub for this island neighbourhood, it serves residents with a range of programming and facilities. Touring cyclists crossing through Queensborough may find it a useful waypoint, though specific cyclist-oriented amenities are not confirmed.
